experimental_method: Winkler titration (amperometric end point) of oxygen in water stirred slowly in contact with a steady stream of CO2-free wet air until a constant saturation value was reached (approached from above and below).
uncertainties_stated: salinity +-0.1 per mille; temperature thermostat +-0.05 C; rms deviation of observed from eq. (1) 0.05 ppm (max 0.11); eq. (2) rms 0.04 ppm (max 0.08)
quality_remarks: Residual oxygen demand of the sea-water 0.002 ppm/h; authors' pure water values up to 4 % lower than the accepted ones. Individual observations not tabulated.
not_extracted_tables: Table I: oxygen content of air-saturated water reported by various workers (literature compilation, not this paper's measurements)
Table III (a, b coefficients, ppm O2 vs temperature and salinity): derived from the authors' fitted equations, not measured values
